newsitem.title: USA: TENNIS-U.S. NAMES FED CUP TEAM FOR FIRST ROUND TITLE DEFENSE.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-U.S. NAMES FED CUP TEAM FOR FIRST ROUND TITLE DEFENSE.

text.p: Mary Joe Fernandez, Chanda Rubin, Gigi Fernandez and Kimberly Po will represent the United States as it begins defence of its Fed Cup title against the Netherlands next month, the U.S. Tennis Association announced on Monday.

"We have a great team with a wonderful blend of rookies and veterans," said Martina Navratilova, who makes her debut as U.S. Fed Cup captain for the March 1-2 first-round tie in Haarlem, the Netherlands.
Mary Joe Fernandez, who is 11-6 in Fed Cup singles and 3-1 in doubles, is the only returning member of the four-woman squad that beat Spain in last year's final.
Fernandez, ranked 15th in singles, played doubles in last year's 5-0 final-round victory for the team that was led by Monica Seles, who is injured, and Lindsay Davenport.
Gigi Fernandez, one of the world's best doubles players, is the team's other seasoned Fed Cup veteran.
Although not selected by former captain Billie Jean King for last year's final, Gigi Fernandez takes a 19-2 Fed Cup doubles record into the first round.
Rubin, who was injured for most of last year, was 1-1 in singles as a member of the 1995 U.S. squad.
The 19th-ranked Po, an Australian Open quarter-finalist this year, will be making her Fed Cup debut.
The United States holds a 5-1 record over the Netherlands in head-to-head Fed Cup meetings.
"We are all looking forward to the challenge," Navratilova said.
